---
title: "Dashboard about Coachella for Step 1"
format: 
  dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    theme: [flatly, styles.scss]
    nav-buttons:
      - icon: globe
        href: https://www.coachella.com
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)

coachella <- read_csv("coachella.csv") |>
  mutate(
    year       = as.numeric(year),
    attendance = as.numeric(attendance),
    daily_avg  = as.numeric(daily_avg)
  )

latest <- coachella |> arrange(desc(year)) |> slice(1)
peak   <- coachella |> slice_max(attendance, n = 1)
```

## Column {width=30%}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Latest Year"
#| icon: calendar-event
#| color: primary
list(value = latest$year)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Latest Attendance"
#| icon: people-fill
#| color: danger
list(value = scales::comma(latest$attendance))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Peak Attendance"
#| icon: trophy-fill
#| color: warning
list(value = scales::comma(peak$attendance),
     subtitle = paste0("in ", peak$year))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Latest Daily Avg"
#| icon: person-arms-up
#| color: success
list(value = scales::comma(latest$daily_avg))
```

## Column {width=40%}

```{r}
#| label: attendance-by-year
#| title: Historical Attendance
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 8
coachella |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = attendance)) +
  # Using the Blue for the area fill
  geom_area(fill = "#07C8F9", alpha = 0.3) + 
  # Using the Pink for the line and points to make the trend "pop"
  geom_line(color = "#F62681", linewidth = 1.2) + 
  geom_point(color = "#F62681", size = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = coachella$year) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Total Attendees") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    # Optional: subtle grid color adjustment for the theme
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90")
  )
```

## Column {width=30%}

### Row {.tabset}

```{r}
#| title: Attendance by Headliner
coachella |>
  mutate(headliner = fct_reorder(headliner, attendance)) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = headliner, x = attendance)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#07C8F9") + # Electric Blue
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(suffix = "K", scale = 1e-3)) +
  labs(x = "Total Attendance", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#| title: Daily Average by Year
coachella |>
  mutate(headliner = fct_reorder(headliner, daily_avg)) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = headliner, x = daily_avg)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#F62681") + # Hot Pink
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(suffix = "K", scale = 1e-3)) +
  labs(x = "Daily Average", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Row

```{r}
#| label: headliner-table
#| title: Headliner History
coachella |>
  arrange(desc(year)) |>
  select(year, headliner, attendance, daily_avg) |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(title = md("**Coachella Headliner History**")) |>
  # Blue header for structure
  tab_style(
    style = cell_fill(color = "#07C8F9"),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(color = "white", weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  ) |>
  # Pink text for the Year to make it pop
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(color = "#F62681", weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = year)
  ) |>
  fmt_number(columns = c(attendance, daily_avg), decimals = 0) |>
  cols_label(
    year       = "Year",
    headliner  = "Headliner",
    attendance = "Total Attendance",
    daily_avg  = "Daily Average"
  ) |>
  opt_row_striping()
```
